subject.why: The subject is clearly a jar of strawberry jam with the gingham cloth cap, string tie, and charming whole strawberry on top as requested.

category.why: The jar floats freely with a slight three-quarter tilt against a saturated gradient background with the repeating magnifying-glass motif, perfectly fitting Category 1.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, watermarks, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The jar is centrally positioned with generous margins on all sides and a bold, chunky silhouette.

colour.why: The warm red tones of the jam, gingham, and strawberry contrast vibrantly against the sunny yellow patterned background.

detail.why: Details are kept bold, large, and stylized without overwhelming micro-textures, clutter, or extra scenery.

style.why: The rendering matches the references with smooth 3D volumes, clean satin highlights, and distinct, readable material finishes for the glass, jam, and cloth.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (100% of the background); planned yellow
